notes.en: Official specifications list a weight of approximately 400 g, a closest focusing distance of 0.24 m, and a largest reproduction ratio of 1:4.6. See the cited specification for the weight/hood convention.

notes.zh: 原版 Summilux-SL 50mm（订货号 11180）为 L 卡口自动对焦镜头。官方数据表标注重量 1065 g、E82 滤镜口径、最近对焦 0.6 m、最大放大倍率 1:10，徕卡明确声明镜身具备防尘防溅密封。

notes.en: Official specifications list a weight of approximately 700 g, a closest focusing distance of 0.6 m, and a largest reproduction ratio of 1:5. See the cited specification for the weight/hood convention.

notes.en: Official specifications list a weight of approximately 856 g, a closest focusing distance of 0.18 m, and a largest reproduction ratio of 1:2.9 (24mm), 1:4.5 (70mm). See the cited specification for weight/hood conventions and zoom-end differences.
notes.zh: 官方规格标注重量约 856 g（遮光罩口径详见官方规格），最近对焦距离 0.18 m，最大放大倍率 1:2.9 (24mm), 1:4.5 (70mm)。变焦两端差异以所引官方规格为准。

notes.en: Official specifications list a weight of approximately 1710 g, a closest focusing distance of 0.6 m, and a largest reproduction ratio of 1:4.8 (90mm), 1:5.0 (280mm). See the cited specification for weight/hood conventions and zoom-end differences.
notes.zh: 官方规格标注重量约 1710 g（官网未明确重量的遮光罩口径），最近对焦距离 0.6 m，最大放大倍率 1:4.8 (90mm), 1:5.0 (280mm)。变焦两端差异以所引官方规格为准。

notes.en: L-Mount zoom lens; lens-only weight approximately 680 g. Official specifications list a 0.3 m minimum focusing distance and 0.5x maximum magnification.

notes.en: L-Mount prime lens; lens-only weight approximately 955 g. Official specifications list a 0.44 m minimum focusing distance and 0.15x maximum magnification.

notes.en: L-Mount zoom lens; lens-only weight approximately 1570 g. The 1570 g weight excludes the hood, caps and external tripod mount; the tripod mount weighs approximately 230 g. Announced in November 2019, with a Japanese on-sale date of January 17, 2020.
notes.zh: L卡口变焦镜头；镜头本体约1570 g。1570 g重量不含遮光罩、镜头盖及外置三脚架座；三脚架座另约230 g。2019年11月公布，日本上市日期为2020年1月17日。

notes.en: L-Mount zoom lens; lens-only weight approximately 350 g. Maximum aperture varies from F3.5 at wide to F5.6 at tele. Minimum focus is 0.15 m at 20–26 mm and 0.40 m at 60 mm; peak magnification 0.43x occurs at 26 mm.
notes.zh: L卡口变焦镜头；镜头本体约350 g。最大光圈为广角端F3.5至长焦端F5.6。20–26 mm焦段最近对焦0.15 m，60 mm端0.40 m；最大0.43倍倍率出现在26 mm。

notes.en: L-Mount prime lens; lens-only weight approximately 355 g. Official specifications list a 0.8 m minimum focusing distance and 0.13x maximum magnification.
notes.zh: L卡口定焦镜头；镜头本体约355 g。官方规格标注最近对焦距离0.8 m，最大放大倍率0.13倍。

notes.en: L-Mount prime lens; lens-only weight approximately 298 g. Official specifications list a 0.204 m minimum focusing distance and 1x maximum magnification.
notes.zh: L卡口定焦镜头；镜头本体约298 g。官方规格标注最近对焦距离0.204 m，最大放大倍率1倍。

notes.en: Mirrorless-native 35mm F1.4 Art prime. Maximum magnification is 1:5.4 (approximately 0.185x), with a 0.30m minimum focusing distance.
notes.zh: 无反原生 35mm F1.4 Art 定焦镜头。最大放大倍率为 1:5.4（约 0.185 倍），最近对焦距离为 0.30 米。

notes.en: Maximum magnification is 1:7.1 (approximately 0.141x); the front filter thread is 72mm. L-Mount weight is 520g.
notes.zh: 最大放大倍率为 1:7.1（约 0.141 倍），前置滤镜口径为 72mm，L 卡口版重 520g。

notes.en: Original I-series DG DN version, launched in December 2020 and now marked discontinued by Sigma. Maximum magnification is 1:6.8 (approximately 0.147x).
notes.zh: 初代 I 系列 DG DN 版本，2020 年 12 月上市，适马现已标注停产。最大放大倍率为 1:6.8（约 0.147 倍）。

notes.en: Maximum magnification is 1:4.1 (approximately 0.244x) at 400mm; minimum focusing distance is 1.12m at 100mm and 1.60m at 400mm. Sigma documents sealing at the mount; full-barrel protection has not been confirmed. Minimum aperture varies from F22 at 100mm to F29 at 400mm.
notes.zh: 400mm 端最大放大倍率为 1:4.1（约 0.244 倍）；100mm 端最近对焦距离为 1.12 米，400mm 端为 1.60 米。适马明确标明卡口密封，整支镜身的防护尚未确认。 最小光圈为 100mm 端 F22 至 400mm 端 F29。

notes.en: Compact constant-F2.8 standard zoom weighing 470g in L-Mount. Maximum magnification is 1:3.3 (approximately 0.303x) at 28mm and 1:4.6 at 70mm. Dust and splash resistance applies to the mount only.
notes.zh: L 卡口版重 470g 的紧凑恒定 F2.8 标准变焦镜头。28mm 端最大放大倍率为 1:3.3（约 0.303 倍），70mm 端为 1:4.6；防尘防溅结构仅应用于卡口。

notes.en: A 1:1 macro prime with a 29.5cm minimum focusing distance, 62mm filter thread and HSM autofocus. L-Mount weight is 715g.
notes.zh: 1:1 微距定焦镜头，最近对焦距离 29.5cm，滤镜口径 62mm，采用 HSM 自动对焦，L 卡口版重 715g。

notes.en: Sports-line super-telephoto zoom with a maximum magnification of 1:2.9 (approximately 0.345x) at 180mm, not 1:1 macro at 600mm. Minimum focusing distance varies from 0.58m to 2.8m; minimum aperture varies from F22 to F29.
notes.zh: Sports 系列超长焦变焦镜头，180mm 端最大放大倍率为 1:2.9（约 0.345 倍），并非 600mm 端 1:1 微距。最近对焦距离随焦段变化，为 0.58 至 2.8 米；最小光圈为 F22 至 F29。

notes.en: Full-frame autofocus prime. Sirui lists L-Mount weight as 550 g and maximum magnification as 1:8.68 (0.1152x). The shared specification table gives a 67 mm filter thread and F1.4-F16 aperture range.
notes.zh: 全画幅自动对焦定焦镜头。思锐明确标注 L 卡口版重 550 g，最大放大倍率为 1:8.68（0.1152 倍）；共用规格表标注 67 mm 滤镜口径，光圈范围 F1.4-F16。

notes.en: Full-frame autofocus prime. Sirui lists L-Mount weight as 495 g, 0.35 m closest focus, 0.14x maximum magnification, a 62 mm filter thread and F1.4-F16 aperture range.
notes.zh: 全画幅自动对焦定焦镜头。思锐明确标注 L 卡口版重 495 g，最近对焦距离 0.35 m、最大倍率 0.14 倍、滤镜口径 62 mm，光圈范围 F1.4-F16。

notes.en: Full-frame manual-focus lens; the official specification lists L-Mount, F1.4-F16 aperture and a 0.5 m minimum focus distance. Weight is published only as 429~457g across mounts, without an L-Mount-specific figure.
notes.zh: 全画幅手动对焦镜头；官方规格明确列出 L 卡口，光圈范围 F1.4-F16，最近对焦距离 0.5 m。官方仅提供跨卡口重量区间 429~457g，未单列 L 卡口重量。

notes.en: Manual-focus full-frame wide-angle lens. The official store confirms that the L-Mount version existed and is discontinued. Its pages disagree on weight and contain a conflicting format entry, so L-Mount-specific weight and close-focus specifications remain unconfirmed. A separate 72 mm filter holder is listed.
notes.zh: 手动对焦全画幅广角镜头。官方商店确认曾推出 L 卡口版本，现已停产。官方页面的重量及画幅表述存在矛盾，L 卡口专属重量和最近对焦规格仍待确认；官方列有独立的 72 mm 滤镜座。

notes.en: Manual-focus full-frame 35 mm lens with an F1.4-F16 aperture range, a 0.3 m minimum focus distance and a 52 mm filter thread. The official listing includes L-Mount; its 274 g weight is not identified by mount.
notes.zh: 手动对焦全画幅 35 mm 镜头，光圈范围 F1.4-F16，最近对焦 0.3 m，滤镜口径 52 mm。官方明确列出 L 卡口，但 274 g 重量未按卡口单独标注。

notes.en: Manual-focus APS-C macro lens with 1:1 maximum magnification, a 0.175 m minimum focus distance and an F2.8-F22 aperture range. The current official listing includes L-Mount; the shared 339 g specification is not identified as an L-Mount weight.
notes.zh: 手动对焦 APS-C 微距镜头，最大放大倍率 1:1，最近对焦距离 0.175 m，光圈范围 F2.8-F22。当前官方产品列表明确包含 L 卡口，但共享规格中的 339 g 未单独标注为 L 卡口重量。

notes.en: Manual-focus full-frame ultra-wide lens. Laowa's Chinese specification explicitly lists L-Mount, F2-F22, 15 cm minimum focus, 0.25x maximum magnification and a 72 mm filter thread. Its approximately 500 g weight is not assigned to a specific mount.
notes.zh: 手动对焦全画幅超广角镜头。老蛙中文规格明确列出 L 口、F2-F22、最近对焦 15 cm、最大倍率 0.25 倍及 72 mm 滤镜。约 500 g 的重量未注明对应卡口。

notes.en: Manual-focus 2x full-frame macro lens. The official Chinese page lists L-Mount, F2.8-F22, 24.7 cm closest focus and a 67 mm filter thread. Its 638 g weight is explicitly for Canon EF, so it does not verify the L-Mount weight.
notes.zh: 手动对焦全画幅 2 倍微距镜头。中文官网列出 L 口、F2.8-F22、最近对焦 24.7 cm 和 67 mm 滤镜。638 g 明确为佳能 EF 卡口重量，不能作为 L 卡口重量的官方确认。

notes.en: APS-C F2.8 ultra-wide zoom with 1:4 maximum magnification at 10mm and a minimum focusing distance of 11.6cm. Sigma documents rubber sealing at the mount; full-barrel protection has not been confirmed.
notes.zh: APS-C 画幅 F2.8 超广角变焦镜头，10mm 端最大放大倍率为 1:4，最近对焦距离为 11.6cm。适马明确标明卡口橡胶密封，整支镜身的防护尚未确认。

notes.en: Full-frame F2.8 ultra-wide zoom with a rear filter holder and no front filter thread. Maximum magnification is 1:7.3 (approximately 0.137x).
notes.zh: 全画幅 F2.8 超广角变焦镜头，配备后置滤镜座，无前置滤镜螺纹。最大放大倍率为 1:7.3（约 0.137 倍）。

notes.en: Full-frame F2.8 wide-angle zoom with an internal zoom mechanism, 72mm filter thread and 450g L-Mount weight. Maximum magnification is 1:5.6 (approximately 0.179x).
notes.zh: 全画幅 F2.8 广角变焦镜头，采用内变焦结构，滤镜口径 72mm，L 卡口版重 450g。最大放大倍率为 1:5.6（约 0.179 倍）。

notes.en: APS-C 18.75x superzoom with OS2 optical stabilization. Maximum magnification is 1:2 at 70mm; minimum focusing distance is 17cm at 16mm and 105cm at 300mm. Minimum aperture varies from F22 to F45.
notes.zh: APS-C 画幅 18.75 倍超级变焦镜头，配备 OS2 光学防抖。70mm 端最大放大倍率为 1:2；16mm 端最近对焦距离为 17cm，300mm 端为 105cm，最小光圈为 F22 至 F45。

notes.en: Compact constant-F2.8 APS-C standard zoom. Maximum magnification is 1:2.8 at 18mm and 1:5 at 50mm; minimum focusing distance ranges from 12.1cm to 30cm.
notes.zh: 紧凑型恒定 F2.8 APS-C 标准变焦镜头。18mm 端最大放大倍率为 1:2.8，50mm 端为 1:5；最近对焦距离为 12.1 至 30cm。

notes.en: Full-frame 20-200mm zoom weighing 550g in L-Mount. It reaches 1:2 maximum magnification at 28-85mm and a minimum focusing distance of 16.5cm at 28mm. Minimum aperture varies from F22 to F40.
notes.zh: 全画幅 20-200mm 变焦镜头，L 卡口版重 550g。28 至 85mm 焦段最大放大倍率为 1:2，28mm 端最近对焦距离为 16.5cm；最小光圈为 F22 至 F40。

notes.en: Original DG DN Art standard zoom, now marked discontinued by Sigma. Maximum magnification is 1:2.9 at 24mm and 1:4.5 at 70mm; minimum focusing distance ranges from 18cm to 38cm.
notes.zh: 初代 DG DN Art 标准变焦镜头，适马现已标注停产。24mm 端最大放大倍率为 1:2.9，70mm 端为 1:4.5；最近对焦距离为 18 至 38cm。

notes.en: Full-frame constant-F1.8 zoom with internal zooming. Minimum focusing distance is 30cm throughout the range; maximum magnification is 1:4 at 45mm.
notes.zh: 全画幅恒定 F1.8 变焦镜头，采用内变焦结构。全焦段最近对焦距离为 30cm，45mm 端最大放大倍率为 1:4。

notes.en: Constant-F2.8 zoom with a 40cm minimum focusing distance across the range. Maximum magnification is 1:3.1 (approximately 0.323x) at 105mm.
notes.zh: 恒定 F2.8 变焦镜头，全焦段最近对焦距离均为 40cm；105mm 端最大放大倍率为 1:3.1（约 0.323 倍）。

notes.en: 10x super-telephoto zoom with OS2 optical stabilization. Maximum magnification is 1:2.4 (approximately 0.417x) at 200mm; minimum focusing distance ranges from 45cm to 260cm and minimum aperture from F22 to F32.
notes.zh: 10 倍超长焦变焦镜头，配备 OS2 光学防抖。200mm 端最大放大倍率为 1:2.4（约 0.417 倍）；最近对焦距离为 45 至 260cm，最小光圈为 F22 至 F32。

notes.en: Constant-F2.8 telephoto zoom with minimum focusing distances of 65cm at 70mm and 100cm at 200mm. Maximum magnification is 1:5.2 (approximately 0.192x) at 200mm.
notes.zh: 恒定 F2.8 长焦变焦镜头，70mm 端最近对焦距离为 65cm，200mm 端为 100cm。200mm 端最大放大倍率为 1:5.2（约 0.192 倍）。

notes.en: L-Mount autofocus zoom with maximum aperture F2 at 35 mm and F2.8 at 150 mm. Minimum focus is 0.32 m / 0.85 m and magnification is 0.184x / 0.18x at the wide / tele ends. Official weight is 1206 g without caps and hood; weather sealing is specified. Minimum aperture varies from F16 to F22.
notes.zh: L 卡口自动对焦变焦镜头，35 mm 端最大光圈 F2、150 mm 端 F2.8。广角／长焦端最近对焦分别为 0.32／0.85 m，倍率分别为 0.184／0.18 倍。不含镜头盖和遮光罩重 1206 g，官方明确标注防尘防溅。最小光圈随焦段由 F16 变化至 F22。

notes.en: Native L-Mount autofocus ultra-wide prime with F1.8-F22 aperture range, 0.27 m minimum focus, 0.1x maximum magnification and a 77 mm filter thread. Viltrox lists approximately 550 g and internal dust sealing.
notes.zh: 原生 L 卡口自动对焦超广角定焦镜头，光圈范围 F1.8-F22、最近对焦 0.27 m、最大倍率 0.1 倍、滤镜口径 77 mm。官方标注约重 550 g，并说明具备内部防尘密封。

notes.en: Full-frame autofocus 24 mm lens with an F1.8-F16 aperture range, a 0.32 m minimum focus distance and a 62 mm filter thread. The official page lists E/Z/L mounts, but its 424 g figure is explicitly for E-mount.
notes.zh: 全画幅自动对焦 24 mm 镜头，光圈范围 F1.8-F16，最近对焦距离 0.32 m，滤镜口径 62 mm。官方列出 E/Z/L 卡口，但 424 g 重量明确标注为 E 卡口数据。

notes.zh: 全画幅自动对焦 35 mm 镜头，光圈范围 F1.8-F16，最近对焦距离 0.4 m，滤镜口径 62 mm。官方列出 E/Z/L 卡口，但 426 g 重量明确标注为 E 卡口数据。

notes.en: L-Mount full-frame autofocus portrait/standard prime. Official specifications list a 421 g weight excluding front and rear caps, an F1.8-F16 aperture range, 0.5 m closest focus and a 62 mm filter thread.
notes.zh: L 卡口全画幅自动对焦定焦镜头。官方规格标注不含前后盖重量 421 g、光圈范围 F1.8-F16、最近对焦距离 0.5 m、滤镜口径 62 mm。

notes.en: L-Mount full-frame autofocus portrait/standard prime. Official specifications list a 443 g weight excluding front and rear caps, an F1.8-F16 aperture range, 0.8 m closest focus and a 62 mm filter thread.

notes.en: Native L-Mount autofocus pancake with a fixed F4.5 aperture, weighing approximately 60 g. The current L-Mount specification lists 0.32 m minimum focus and 0.1x maximum magnification.
notes.zh: 原生 L 卡口自动对焦饼干镜头，光圈固定为 F4.5，约重 60 g。现行 L 卡口官方规格明确标注最近对焦 0.32 m、最大放大倍率 0.1 倍。

notes.en: Full-frame manual-focus lens; the official specification lists L-Mount, F1.4-F16 aperture and a 0.5 m minimum focus distance.
notes.zh: 全画幅手动对焦镜头；官方规格明确列出 L 卡口，光圈范围 F1.4-F16，最近对焦距离 0.5 m。

notes.en: Official L-Mount specifications: 3985 g, a minimum focusing distance of 2.8 m, and a maximum magnification of 1:6 (approximately 0.167x). Peak magnification occurs at 470 mm; close focus is 2.8 m at 300 mm and 4.5 m at 600 mm. The 40.5 mm filter holder is at the rear, not a front filter thread. The L-Mount version was released in 2025.
notes.zh: 官方 L 卡口规格：重量 3985 g，最近对焦距离 2.8 m，最大放大倍率 1:6（约 0.167 倍）。 最大放大倍率出现在 470 mm；300 mm 端最近对焦 2.8 m，600 mm 端为 4.5 m。40.5 mm 为后置滤镜座，并非前置滤镜口径。 L 卡口版本于 2025 年上市。

notes.en: Official L-Mount specifications: 535 g, a minimum focusing distance of 0.28 m, and a maximum magnification of 1:4.8 (approximately 0.208x). Peak magnification occurs at 40 mm. The L-Mount version was released in 2025.
notes.zh: 官方 L 卡口规格：重量 535 g，最近对焦距离 0.28 m，最大放大倍率 1:4.8（约 0.208 倍）。 最大放大倍率出现在 40 mm 端。 L 卡口版本于 2025 年上市。

notes.en: Official L-Mount specifications: 530 g, a minimum focusing distance of 0.28 m, and a maximum magnification of 1:5.4 (approximately 0.185x). The L-Mount version was released in 2026.
notes.zh: 官方 L 卡口规格：重量 530 g，最近对焦距离 0.28 m，最大放大倍率 1:5.4（约 0.185 倍）。 L 卡口版本于 2026 年上市。

notes.en: Official L-Mount specifications: 905 g, a minimum focusing distance of 0.84 m, and a maximum magnification of 1:8.9 (approximately 0.112x). The L-Mount version was released in 2026.
notes.zh: 官方 L 卡口规格：重量 905 g，最近对焦距离 0.84 m，最大放大倍率 1:8.9（约 0.112 倍）。 L 卡口版本于 2026 年上市。

notes.en: Official L-Mount specifications: 385 g, a minimum focusing distance of 0.158 m, and a maximum magnification of 1:2.3 (approximately 0.435x). Minimum focus of 15.8 cm is at 28 mm, while maximum magnification is at 35 mm; minimum aperture varies from F22 to F32 across the zoom range.
notes.zh: 官方 L 卡口规格：重量 385 g，最近对焦距离 0.158 m，最大放大倍率 1:2.3（约 0.435 倍）。 15.8 cm 最近对焦距离出现在 28 mm，最大放大倍率则出现在 35 mm；最小光圈随焦段在 F22 至 F32 之间变化。

notes.en: Official specifications list a weight of approximately 572 g, a closest focusing distance of 0.19 m, and a largest reproduction ratio of 1:3.3 (28mm), 1:4.6 (70mm). See the cited specification for weight/hood conventions and zoom-end differences.
notes.zh: 官方规格标注重量约 572 g（遮光罩口径详见官方规格），最近对焦距离 0.19 m，最大放大倍率 1:3.3 (28mm), 1:4.6 (70mm)。变焦两端差异以所引官方规格为准。

notes.en: Official specifications list a weight of approximately 584 g, a closest focusing distance of 0.5 m, and a largest reproduction ratio of 1:7.6. See the cited specification for the weight/hood convention. Announced on 25 June 2026; the official announcement schedules availability from the end of 2026.
notes.zh: 官方规格标注重量约 584 g（遮光罩口径详见官方规格），最近对焦距离 0.5 m，最大放大倍率 1:7.6。 2026年6月25日公布，官方公告计划于2026年底起供应。

notes.en: Official specifications list a weight of approximately 801 g, a closest focusing distance of 0.29 m, and a largest reproduction ratio of 1:0.997 (approximately 1:1). See the cited specification for the weight/hood convention. Announced on 25 June 2026; the official announcement schedules availability from the end of 2026.
notes.zh: 官方规格标注重量约 801 g（遮光罩口径详见官方规格），最近对焦距离 0.29 m，最大放大倍率 1:0.997 (approximately 1:1)。 2026年6月25日公布，官方公告计划于2026年底起供应。

notes.en: L-Mount prime lens; lens-only weight approximately 142 g. Announced in September 2026; the official Japanese release states planned availability in late October 2026. Actual first sale has not been confirmed as of October 21, 2026.
notes.zh: L卡口定焦镜头；镜头本体约142 g。2026年9月公布，日本官方公告计划于2026年10月下旬上市；截至2026年10月21日，尚未确认实际首次发售。

notes.en: Full-frame autofocus lens; the official specification lists L-Mount, F1.8-F16 aperture and a 0.48 m minimum focus distance. Weight is published only as 156-167g across mounts, without an L-Mount-specific figure.
notes.zh: 全画幅自动对焦镜头；官方规格明确列出 L 卡口，光圈范围 F1.8-F16，最近对焦距离 0.48 m。官方仅提供跨卡口重量区间 156-167g，未单列 L 卡口重量。

notes.en: Full-frame autofocus lens; the official specification lists L-Mount, F1.8-F16 aperture and a 0.8 m minimum focus distance. Weight is published only as 332~338g across mounts, without an L-Mount-specific figure.
notes.zh: 全画幅自动对焦镜头；官方规格明确列出 L 卡口，光圈范围 F1.8-F16，最近对焦距离 0.8 m。官方仅提供跨卡口重量区间 332~338g，未单列 L 卡口重量。

notes.en: Full-frame manual-focus lens; the official specification lists L-Mount, F2.8-F16 aperture and a 0.2 m minimum focus distance. Weight is published only as 437-445g across mounts, without an L-Mount-specific figure. The 77 mm filter size refers to a filter holder.
notes.zh: 全画幅手动对焦镜头；官方规格明确列出 L 卡口，光圈范围 F2.8-F16，最近对焦距离 0.2 m。官方仅提供跨卡口重量区间 437-445g，未单列 L 卡口重量。77 mm 滤镜口径指滤镜座规格。

notes.en: Full-frame manual-focus lens; the official specification lists L-Mount, F4-F16 aperture and a 0.3 m minimum focus distance. Weight is published only as 1051~1056g across mounts, without an L-Mount-specific figure.
notes.zh: 全画幅手动对焦镜头；官方规格明确列出 L 卡口，光圈范围 F4-F16，最近对焦距离 0.3 m。官方仅提供跨卡口重量区间 1051~1056g，未单列 L 卡口重量。

notes.en: Full-frame autofocus fisheye with a 185° field of view, a 0.15 m minimum focus distance and an F2.5-F16 aperture range. Filters are not supported. The official 504 g weight is for E-mount; only a mount dust-sealing gasket is described.
notes.zh: 全画幅自动对焦鱼眼镜头，视角 185°，最近对焦距离 0.15 m，光圈范围 F2.5-F16，不支持滤镜。官方 504 g 为 E 卡口重量；防护说明仅明确卡口防尘密封圈。

notes.en: Full-frame autofocus telephoto prime with a 0.68 m minimum focus distance, 0.25x maximum magnification, an 82 mm filter thread and dust/drip-resistant seals. The official page lists E/Z/L mounts, but the 1014 g weight is explicitly for E-mount.
notes.zh: 全画幅自动对焦长焦定焦镜头，最近对焦距离 0.68 m，最大放大倍率 0.25 倍，滤镜口径 82 mm；官方说明有防尘防滴密封。官方列出 E/Z/L 卡口，但 1014 g 明确为 E 卡口重量。

notes.en: Full-frame autofocus 40 mm prime with an F2.5-F16 aperture range, 0.4 m closest focus and a 46 mm filter thread. The official listing includes L-Mount, but its 90 g weight is for FE-mount.
notes.zh: 全画幅自动对焦 40 mm 定焦镜头，光圈范围 F2.5-F16，最近对焦距离 0.4 m，滤镜口径 46 mm。官方明确包含 L 卡口，但 90 g 标注为 FE 卡口重量。

notes.en: Manual-focus full-frame ultra-wide lens with an F2.8-F22 aperture range, 0.43 m closest focus and a removable hood that accepts 77 mm filters. The official 504 g figure is identified as E-mount weight.
notes.zh: 手动对焦全画幅超广角镜头，光圈范围 F2.8-F22，最近对焦距离 0.43 m，可拆卸遮光罩支持 77 mm 滤镜。官方 504 g 标注为 E 卡口重量。

notes.en: Manual-focus full-frame portrait lens with an F1.4-F16 aperture range, a 0.88 m minimum focus distance and a 58 mm filter thread. The official listing includes L-Mount; the shared 408 g figure is not separated by mount.
notes.zh: 手动对焦全画幅人像镜头，光圈范围 F1.4-F16，最近对焦距离 0.88 m，滤镜口径 58 mm。官方列出 L 卡口，但共享规格表中的 408 g 未按卡口区分。

notes.en: Full-frame autofocus lens offered in L-Mount. Official optical specifications list F1.8-F16, 0.65 m closest focus and a 62 mm filter thread. Maximum magnification is 0.11x. The official table separately lists 369 g for L-Mount.
notes.zh: 官方列有 L 卡口的全画幅自动对焦镜头。官方光学规格为 F1.8-F16，最近对焦 0.65 m，滤镜口径 62 mm。最大放大倍率为 0.11 倍。官方单独标注 L 卡口重量为 369 g。

notes.en: L-Mount autofocus ultra-wide zoom with an F2.8-F22 aperture range, 0.18 m minimum focus, 77 mm filter thread and 441 g weight without caps and hood. Maximum magnification is 0.17x at the wide end and 0.26x at the tele end; weather sealing is specified.
notes.zh: L 卡口自动对焦超广角变焦，光圈范围 F2.8-F22、最近对焦 0.18 m、77 mm 滤镜，不含镜头盖和遮光罩重 441 g。广角／长焦端最大倍率分别为 0.17／0.26 倍，官方明确标注防尘防溅。

notes.en: L-Mount autofocus telephoto zoom with an F2.8-F22 aperture range and a 77 mm filter thread. Official weight is 727.8 g without caps and hood (rounded to 728 g here). Minimum focus is 0.35 m / 0.79 m and magnification is 0.26x / 0.21x at the wide / tele ends; weather sealing is specified.
notes.zh: L 卡口自动对焦长焦变焦，光圈范围 F2.8-F22、77 mm 滤镜。官方不含镜头盖和遮光罩重 727.8 g（此处四舍五入为 728 g）。广角／长焦端最近对焦分别为 0.35／0.79 m，倍率分别为 0.26／0.21 倍，明确标注防尘防溅。

notes.en: Full-frame 0.5x wide-angle macro. Laowa lists Leica L among manual-aperture mounts, 12.9 cm closest focus and a 62 mm filter thread. The approximately 308 g weight is not individually specified for L-Mount.
notes.zh: 全画幅 0.5 倍广角微距镜头。老蛙将 L 口列为手动光圈版本，最近对焦 12.9 cm，62 mm 滤镜。约 308 g 的重量未单独注明 L 卡口。

notes.en: Manual-focus full-frame fisheye zoom. The Chinese specification lists L-Mount, F2.8-F22, 16 cm minimum focus, 0.23x magnification and no filter thread. Approximately 650 g is the published mirrorless weight, without a separate L-Mount measurement.
notes.zh: 手动对焦全画幅鱼眼变焦镜头。中文规格列出 L 口、F2.8-F22、最近对焦 16 cm、最大倍率 0.23 倍及无滤镜口。无反版公布重量约 650 g，未单独给出 L 卡口测量。

notes.en: The L-Mount version is manual focus, with an F4.5-F32 aperture range; autofocus versions are for EF/E/Z/X. The official specification lists 30 cm minimum focus, 1.5x magnification and a 62 mm filter thread. Its 521.6 g weight is explicitly the Sony E version, not L-Mount.
notes.zh: L 卡口版为手动对焦，光圈范围 F4.5-F32；EF/E/Z/X 为自动对焦版。官方标注最近对焦 30 cm、最大倍率 1.5 倍及 62 mm 滤镜。521.6 g 明确为索尼 E 版重量，不是 L 卡口重量。

notes.en: Manual-focus tilt-shift macro lens; the official Chinese page lists L-Mount, F2.8-F22, 22.8 cm closest focus, 0.5x maximum magnification and a 77 mm filter thread. The 1350 g specification is for Sony E without hood, support bracket or caps.
notes.zh: 手动对焦移轴微距镜头。中文官网列出 L 口、F2.8-F22、最近对焦 22.8 cm、最大倍率 0.5 倍及 77 mm 滤镜。1350 g 明确为索尼 E 版，不含遮光罩、支架及镜头盖。

notes.en: Manual-focus 1-5x ultra-macro lens with an F2.8-F11 aperture range. The Chinese specification lists L-Mount and no filter thread. Its 40.35 mm working distance is not a minimum focusing distance; the official minimum focusing distance is N/A.
notes.zh: 手动对焦 1-5 倍超微距镜头，光圈范围 F2.8-F11。中文规格列出 L 口及无滤镜口。40.35 mm 为工作距离，不是最近对焦距离；官方最近摄影距离标为 N/A。

notes.en: Manual-focus 5-10x ultra-macro lens with an F1.7-F5.6 aperture range. The Chinese specification lists L-Mount and no filter thread. Its 22.48 mm working distance is not a minimum focusing distance; the official minimum focusing distance is N/A.
notes.zh: 手动对焦 5-10 倍超微距镜头，光圈范围 F1.7-F5.6。中文规格列出 L 口及无滤镜口。22.48 mm 为工作距离，不是最近对焦距离；官方最近摄影距离标为 N/A。

notes.en: Manual-focus ultra-macro lens offered in L-Mount. Official specification lists 1-5x magnification, 279 mm focusing distance at 1x and 272 mm at 5x; working distances are separately 150 mm and 65 mm. It has a 58 mm filter thread; the 690 g weight is not mount-specific and a minimum aperture is not stated.
notes.zh: 提供 L 卡口的手动对焦超微距镜头。官方标注 1-5 倍放大，1 倍／5 倍时摄影距离分别为 279／272 mm；工作距离另为 150／65 mm。滤镜口径 58 mm；690 g 未注明卡口，最小光圈未公布。

notes.en: Full-frame autofocus portrait prime offered in E/L/Z mounts. The official specification image confirms an F1.8-F16 aperture range and 0.8 m minimum focus. Its 441 g figure is marked Sony E, and the L-Mount weight and maximum magnification remain unconfirmed.
notes.zh: 提供 E/L/Z 卡口的全画幅自动对焦人像定焦镜头。官方规格图确认光圈范围 F1.8-F16、最近对焦 0.8 m；441 g 明确标为索尼 E 版，L 卡口重量和最大放大倍率仍待确认。

notes.en: Full-frame manual-focus circular fisheye offered in E/L/RF/Z mounts. The official specification image confirms F2.8-F16, 0.08 m minimum focus and no filter support. Its approximately 340 g weight is marked Sony E, so it does not verify the L-Mount weight.
notes.zh: 提供 E/L/RF/Z 卡口的全画幅手动对焦圆形鱼眼镜头。官方规格图确认 F2.8-F16、最近对焦 0.08 m 及不支持滤镜。约 340 g 明确标为索尼 E 版，不能确认 L 卡口重量。

notes.en: Manual-focus full-frame prime offered in L-Mount. The official page confirms F1.4-F16, 0.3 m minimum focus, a 49 mm filter thread and 218 g weight. Maximum magnification and body sealing are not specified.
notes.zh: 提供 L 卡口的手动对焦全画幅定焦镜头。官方页面确认 F1.4-F16、最近对焦 0.3 m、49 mm 滤镜和 218 g 重量；未公布最大放大倍率及镜身密封规格。

notes.en: L-Mount zoom lens; lens-only weight approximately 985 g. The current S-R70200A model has a fluorine coating, optical image stabilization and an AF/MF focus clutch. Its first on-sale date has not been confirmed from an official announcement.
notes.zh: L卡口变焦镜头；镜头本体约985 g。当前S-R70200A型号具备氟涂层、光学防抖及AF/MF对焦离合机构；未从官方发布公告确认首次上市日期。

notes.en: Official L-Mount specifications: 745 g, a minimum focusing distance of 0.4 m, and a maximum magnification of 1:6.2 (approximately 0.161x). The L-Mount version was released in 2024.
notes.zh: 官方 L 卡口规格：重量 745 g，最近对焦距离 0.4 m，最大放大倍率 1:6.2（约 0.161 倍）。 L 卡口版本于 2024 年上市。

notes.en: Official L-Mount specifications: 630 g, a minimum focusing distance of 0.85 m, and a maximum magnification of 1:8.4 (approximately 0.119x). The L-Mount version was released in 2020.

notes.en: Official L-Mount specifications: 745 g, a minimum focusing distance of 0.17 m, and a maximum magnification of 1:2.7 (approximately 0.37x). Minimum focus is 17 cm at the wide end and 34 cm at the tele end; reproduction ratios are 1:2.7 and 1:4 respectively. The L-Mount version was released in 2024.
notes.zh: 官方 L 卡口规格：重量 745 g，最近对焦距离 0.17 m，最大放大倍率 1:2.7（约 0.37 倍）。 广角端最近对焦 17 cm、长焦端为 34 cm，对应放大倍率分别为 1:2.7 和 1:4。 L 卡口版本于 2024 年上市。

notes.zh: 官方 L 卡口规格：重量 1035 g，最近对焦距离 0.276 m，最大放大倍率 1:7.1（约 0.141 倍）。 适马已将此版本标注为停产。

notes.en: Official L-Mount specifications: 755 g, a minimum focusing distance of 0.25 m, and a maximum magnification of 1:5.3 (approximately 0.189x). This version is marked discontinued by Sigma.

notes.en: Official L-Mount specifications: 960 g, a minimum focusing distance of 0.28 m, and a maximum magnification of 1:5.4 (approximately 0.185x). This version is marked discontinued by Sigma. The L-Mount version was released in 2020.
notes.zh: 官方 L 卡口规格：重量 960 g，最近对焦距离 0.28 m，最大放大倍率 1:5.4（约 0.185 倍）。 适马已将此版本标注为停产。 L 卡口版本于 2020 年上市。

notes.en: Official L-Mount specifications: 755 g, a minimum focusing distance of 0.3 m, and a maximum magnification of 1:5.2 (approximately 0.192x). This version is marked discontinued by Sigma.
notes.zh: 官方 L 卡口规格：重量 755 g，最近对焦距离 0.3 m，最大放大倍率 1:5.2（约 0.192 倍）。 适马已将此版本标注为停产。

notes.en: Official L-Mount specifications: 905 g, a minimum focusing distance of 0.4 m, and a maximum magnification of 1:5.6 (approximately 0.179x). This version is marked discontinued by Sigma.
notes.zh: 官方 L 卡口规格：重量 905 g，最近对焦距离 0.4 m，最大放大倍率 1:5.6（约 0.179 倍）。 适马已将此版本标注为停产。

notes.en: Official L-Mount specifications: 1215 g, a minimum focusing distance of 0.85 m, and a maximum magnification of 1:8.5 (approximately 0.118x). This version is marked discontinued by Sigma. The official page confirms a rubber sealing gasket at the mount. Sigma also explicitly describes a dust- and splash-resistant structure.
notes.zh: 官方 L 卡口规格：重量 1215 g，最近对焦距离 0.85 m，最大放大倍率 1:8.5（约 0.118 倍）。 适马已将此版本标注为停产。 官方页面确认卡口配有橡胶密封圈。 适马亦明确描述其具备防尘防溅结构。

notes.en: Official L-Mount specifications: 1220 g, a minimum focusing distance of 0.875 m, and a maximum magnification of 1:5 (approximately 0.2x). This version is marked discontinued by Sigma.
notes.zh: 官方 L 卡口规格：重量 1220 g，最近对焦距离 0.875 m，最大放大倍率 1:5（约 0.2 倍）。 适马已将此版本标注为停产。

notes.en: Official specifications list a weight of approximately 700 g, a closest focusing distance of 0.24 m, and a largest reproduction ratio of 1:5.0. See the cited specification for the weight/hood convention.
notes.zh: 官方规格标注重量约 700 g（遮光罩口径详见官方规格），最近对焦距离 0.24 m，最大放大倍率 1:5.0。

notes.en: Official specifications list a weight of approximately 855 g, a closest focusing distance of 0.28 m, and a largest reproduction ratio of 1:7.4 (24mm). See the cited specification for weight/hood conventions and zoom-end differences. The hood is permanently mounted and a rear holder takes foil filters.
notes.zh: 官方规格标注重量约 855 g（遮光罩口径详见官方规格），最近对焦距离 0.28 m，最大放大倍率 1:7.4 (24mm)。变焦两端差异以所引官方规格为准。 遮光罩为固定式，卡口处设插片滤镜座。

notes.en: Official specifications list a weight of approximately 1540 g, a closest focusing distance of 0.65 m, and a largest reproduction ratio of 1:5.1 (200mm). See the cited specification for weight/hood conventions and zoom-end differences.
notes.zh: 官方规格标注重量约 1540 g（遮光罩口径详见官方规格），最近对焦距离 0.65 m，最大放大倍率 1:5.1 (200mm)。变焦两端差异以所引官方规格为准。

notes.en: L-Mount prime lens; lens-only weight approximately 58 g. Fixed F8 aperture and manual focus only; no filter attachment, optical stabilization or dust/splash resistance is listed in the official North American specifications.
notes.zh: L卡口定焦镜头；镜头本体约58 g。固定F8光圈且仅支持手动对焦；北美官方规格明确无滤镜接口、光学防抖及防尘防溅。

notes.en: L-Mount full-frame autofocus Air-series prime. Official specifications list F4-F16, 0.13 m minimum focus, 0.23x maximum magnification, a 58 mm filter thread and approximately 172 g; the product description states a sealed body, without an IP rating.
notes.zh: L 卡口全画幅自动对焦 Air 系列定焦镜头。官方规格为 F4-F16、最近对焦 0.13 m、最大倍率 0.23 倍、58 mm 滤镜、约重 172 g；产品说明称镜身具备密封，未给出 IP 等级。

notes.en: L-Mount full-frame autofocus Air-series 20 mm prime. The official L-Mount page lists the optical and physical specifications. Its water- and dust-resistant front-element coating does not establish whole-body weather sealing.
notes.zh: L 卡口全画幅自动对焦 Air 系列 20 mm 定焦镜头。官方 L 卡口产品页列有光学和物理规格；前镜片防水防尘镀膜不等于整支镜头具备防尘防溅密封。

notes.en: L-Mount full-frame autofocus Air-series 40 mm prime. The official L-Mount page lists the optical and physical specifications. Its water- and dust-resistant front-element coating does not establish whole-body weather sealing.
notes.zh: L 卡口全画幅自动对焦 Air 系列 40 mm 定焦镜头。官方 L 卡口产品页列有光学和物理规格；前镜片防水防尘镀膜不等于整支镜头具备防尘防溅密封。

notes.en: L-Mount full-frame autofocus Air-series 50 mm prime. The official L-Mount page lists the optical and physical specifications. Its water- and dust-resistant front-element coating does not establish whole-body weather sealing.

notes.en: Manual-focus full-frame tilt-shift lens. Laowa's Chinese page explicitly lists L-Mount, F2-F22, 25 cm minimum focus, 0.194x magnification and a 77 mm filter thread. Panasonic users should check body compatibility because Laowa warns of mechanical interference with some bodies.
notes.zh: 手动对焦全画幅移轴镜头。老蛙中文官网明确列出 L 口、F2-F22、最近对焦 25 cm、最大倍率 0.194 倍及 77 mm 滤镜。官方提醒部分松下机身与镜头存在结构干涉，购买前应核对机身兼容性。

notes.en: The L-Mount version is manual focus, with F2.8-F22, 18 cm minimum focus, 1x magnification and a 67 mm filter thread. The official Chinese page gives weights only for EF/E/Z autofocus versions; the 530 g EF figure does not confirm L-Mount weight.
notes.zh: L 卡口版本为手动对焦，F2.8-F22、最近对焦 18 cm、最大倍率 1 倍、67 mm 滤镜。中文官网仅给出 EF/E/Z 自动对焦版重量；530 g 为 EF 版数据，不能确认 L 口版重量。

notes.en: The L-Mount version is manual focus, with F2.8-F22, 14 cm minimum focus, 0.21x magnification and a 72 mm filter thread. Laowa explicitly lists L among MF mounts; the published 480 g weight is for the MF RF version, not L-Mount.
notes.zh: L 卡口版本为手动对焦，F2.8-F22、最近对焦 14 cm、最大倍率 0.21 倍、72 mm 滤镜。官方将 L 列入 MF 卡口；480 g 明确为 MF RF 版重量，不是 L 卡口重量。

notes.en: Manual-focus 1:1 telephoto macro offered in Leica L. Official specifications list F4-F32, 0.48 m minimum focusing distance and a 67 mm filter thread. The published 1300 g weight is not assigned to a specific mount.
notes.zh: 提供 Leica L 卡口的手动对焦 1:1 长焦微距镜头。官方规格列出 F4-F32、最近对焦 0.48 m 和 67 mm 滤镜。公布的 1300 g 重量未注明对应卡口。

notes.en: Full-frame manual-focus lens; the official specification lists L-Mount, F6.3-F32 aperture and a 3.3 m minimum focus distance. Weight is published only as 1564~1617g across mounts, without an L-Mount-specific figure.
notes.zh: 全画幅手动对焦镜头；官方规格明确列出 L 卡口，光圈范围 F6.3-F32，最近对焦距离 3.3 m。官方仅提供跨卡口重量区间 1564~1617g，未单列 L 卡口重量。

notes.en: Manual-focus full-frame 2x macro lens with 14 elements in 10 groups, a 0.25 m minimum focus distance and a 67 mm filter thread. The official page lists L-Mount and a 700-748 g weight range across mounts; it does not identify the L-Mount weight.
notes.zh: 手动对焦全画幅 2 倍微距镜头，10 组 14 片，最近对焦 0.25 m，滤镜口径 67 mm。官方明确列出 L 卡口，但只提供跨卡口 700-748 g 重量区间，未单列 L 卡口重量。

notes.en: Manual-focus full-frame L-Mount listing. Official specifications give an F1.2-F22 aperture range, 0.6 m closest focus and a 67 mm filter thread. Maximum magnification, optical stabilization and weather protection are not confirmed by the available official specifications.
notes.zh: 官方商店列为 L 卡口全画幅手动对焦镜头。官方规格为光圈 F1.2-F22，最近对焦 0.6 m，滤镜口径 67 mm。现有官方资料未确认最大放大倍率、光学防抖及防护性能。

notes.en: Manual-focus full-frame L-Mount listing. Official specifications give an F1.7-F22 aperture range, 0.5 m closest focus and a 52 mm filter thread. Maximum magnification, optical stabilization and weather protection are not confirmed by the available official specifications.
